sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungarian syntax allows extensive left-branching pre-nominal modification. Instead of a relative clause ('a törvénytervezet, amelyet a parlament a múlt héten fogadott el'), formal Hungarian compresses this into a participle preceding the noun: 'a parlament által a múlt héten elfogadott törvénytervezet'.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: When stacking oblique modifiers before a participle, the chronological or topical elements precede the agent ('által') or instrument ('-val/-vel'), which immediately precedes the participle head.
